title: The Breath of God Will Complete the Work in You
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful and poignant message about the life-giving power of the Bible and God's unrelenting pursuit of our hearts. Drawing from the story of Lazarus' miraculous resurrection, Pastor Zehner shows us that Jesus doesn't do a half job - He completes every work He starts in us, and we can trust Him to finish what He began in us. Listen in to be encouraged and inspired to stay the course with God and trust in His goodness and faithfulness.
